cd /workspace/tmp && cat > z3test.py <<'EOF'
import z3, time
x = z3.Int('x'); y = z3.Int('y')
opt = z3.Optimize()
opt.set(priority='box')
opt.add(x>=0, x<=100, y>=0, y<=100, x+y<=50)
h1 = opt.minimize(x)
h2 = opt.maximize(y)
print('check', opt.check())
print('x lower/upper', opt.lower(h1), opt.upper(h1))
print('y lower/upper', opt.lower(h2), opt.upper(h2))
m = opt.model(); print(m)
EOF

cd /workspace/tmp && cat > z3test2.py <<'EOF'
import z3, time
n=14
f=[z3.Bool('f%d'%i) for i in range(n)]
obs=[]
for i in range(256):
    v = z3.Int('v%d'%i)
    obs.append((v, i%50, i%50+5))
s=z3.Solver()
s.add(z3.PbLe([(x,1) for x in f], 3))
for i,(v,lo,hi) in enumerate(obs):
    d = f[i%n]
    s.add(z3.Implies(z3.Not(d), z3.And(v>=lo, v<=hi)))
s.add(z3.Or(*f))
t=time.time()
print(s.check(), time.time()-t)
EOF
python3 z3test2.py
